envVars.name: WEBULL_APP_KEY
envVars.description: Webull OpenAPI app key. Without it prices fall back to Yahoo and the account and order tools are unavailable; everything else still works.

envVars.name: WEBULL_APP_SECRET
envVars.description: Webull OpenAPI app secret. Signs every request; the app key alone cannot authenticate.

envVars.name: WEBULL_REGION_ID
envVars.description: Webull region: us, hk, jp, sg, th, my, uk, au, eu, br, mx, za.

envVars.name: WEBULL_ENVIRONMENT
envVars.description: prod trades the real account. paper repoints the ENTIRE client at Webull's sandbox, quotes included, and needs separate sandbox credentials — production keys return 401 there.

envVars.name: FINANCE_BROKER
envVars.description: Which broker adapter the account and order tools use, and where prices come from: webull, saxo or ibkr. Only the tools the configured broker can serve are registered, so the tool list never advertises one that would refuse. Webull is the only adapter that has been run against a live account; saxo and ibkr are written from published documentation and say so in every result they produce.

envVars.name: SAXO_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=saxo. A 24-hour simulation token comes from Saxo's Developer Portal with no approval process and no live money; live access needs the OAuth2 code flow. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.

envVars.name: SAXO_ENVIRONMENT
envVars.description: sim or live. Selects Saxo's simulation gateway or the live one.

envVars.name: IBKR_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=ibkr. This is the Client Portal Web API, not the TWS socket API: run IBKR's Client Portal Gateway and log in at https://localhost:5000 in a browser first. A paper account works and is the better choice. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.

envVars.name: IBKR_TLS_INSECURE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to accept the Client Portal Gateway's self-signed certificate unverified, or point IBKR_CACERT at it instead. This is a decision about the connection carrying your orders, so it is never made for you.

envVars.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: A descriptive User-Agent with a real contact address, e.g. 'Jane Doe (jane@example.com)'. The SEC's fair-access policy requires it and the filings tools refuse to send requests without one rather than risk an IP ban.

envVars.name: BLS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Optional. BLS allows 25 macro queries a day without a key; a free key raises it to 500 and extends history from 10 to 20 years.

envVars.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
envVars.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

envVars.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY

envVars.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

envVars.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and UMBRIEL_ALLOW.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR
envVars.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT
envVars.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
envVars.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
envVars.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

envVars.name: CONFIG
envVars.description: Path to your configuration file

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

envVars.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte cap for content bodies (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs) returned by get-page, get-pages, parse-wikitext, and compare-pages. Oversized bodies are truncated with a trailing marker.

envVars.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
envVars.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

envVars.name: MCP_METRICS
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
envVars.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
envVars.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

envVars.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

envVars.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
envVars.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Type of MCP server transport

envVars.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport

envVars.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

envVars.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

envVars.name: RERANK_MODE
envVars.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

envVars.name: WINDOWS_MODE
envVars.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

envVars.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

envVars.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

envVars.name: MEMORY_DIR
envVars.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

envVars.name: TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity.

envVars.name: LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for persistent log files. Unset by default — logs go to stdout only. Set to /data/logs to also write date-stamped .log files to the persistent volume.

envVars.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
envVars.description: Days to retain persistent log files before cleanup.

envVars.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR and "Daily Notes".

envVars.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: "Daily Notes", "Templates", MEMORY_DIR.

envVars.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

envVars.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

servers.description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

envVars.name: OFW_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com).

envVars.name: OFW_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see OFW_USERNAME.

envVars.name: OFW_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: OFW_CALENDAR_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to "true" to register calendar write tools (create/update/delete event) in "drafts" write mode. Events have no draft stage but are reversible. Never overrides "none".

envVars.name: OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ
envVars.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

envVars.name: OFW_FETCH_UNREAD_BODIES
envVars.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

servers.name: io.github.claymore666/ccu-mcp
servers.title: io.github.claymore666/ccu-mcp
servers.description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

envVars.name: CCU_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

envVars.name: CCU_PASSWORD
envVars.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login)

envVars.name: CCU_USER
envVars.description: CCU username

envVars.name: CCU_HTTPS
envVars.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

envVars.name: CCU_PORT
envVars.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

envVars.name: CCU_PROFILES
envVars.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

envVars.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
envVars.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

envVars.name: CCU_CA_CERT
envVars.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

envVars.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

envVars.name: CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
envVars.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

envVars.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
envVars.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because a bulk body streams for minutes where a metadata call answers in seconds. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

envVars.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
envVars.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
envVars.description: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to. Must be writable by the server process. Defaults to a 'mcp-canvas' directory under the OS temp directory.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
envVars.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

envVars.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because a bulk body streams for minutes where a metadata call answers in seconds. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

envVars.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
envVars.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
envVars.description: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to. Must be writable by the server process. Defaults to a 'mcp-canvas' directory under the OS temp directory.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
envVars.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

envVars.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.

envVars.name: NTFY_SERVERS
envVars.description: JSON array of `{ baseUrl, authToken? | authUsername?+authPassword? }` entries — one per ntfy server. First entry is the default base. Auth is scoped to the entry's `baseUrl`; per-call `base_url` overrides that match a registered base forward that server's auth. Takes precedence over the single-server NTFY_BASE_URL / NTFY_AUTH_* shorthand.

envVars.name: NTFY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Single-server shorthand — base URL of the ntfy server (no trailing slash). Used when NTFY_SERVERS is unset.

envVars.name: NTFY_DEFAULT_TOPIC
envVars.description: Topic used when a tool call omits `topic`. Treat the topic name as a secret — anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer access token (`tk_…`) for the single-server shorthand. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME / NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME
envVars.description: Basic-auth username for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Basic-auth password for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME.

envVars.name: NTFY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

envVars.name: NTFY_MAX_RETRIES
envVars.description: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (5xx, network, 429).

envVars.name: NTFY_BLOCK_PRIVATE_HOSTS
envVars.description: When true, a per-call `base_url` override must resolve to a public address and its redirects are not followed. Servers registered under NTFY_SERVERS / NTFY_BASE_URL are exempt. Turn it on where callers you do not control can reach the server.

envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

envVars.name: LOGS_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for file-based logs (Node only; ignored on Workers).

envVars.name: OTEL_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable OpenTelemetry instrumentation (spans, metrics, completion logs).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
envVars.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_OMNISEARCH_URL
envVars.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port.

servers.description: Semantic code & doc search with keyword boost. AST code nav, auto HF mirror, local, privacy-first.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_WATCH
envVars.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

envVars.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR
envVars.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

envVars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTPS proxy URL for downloading embedding models (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Required only if behind a corporate proxy.

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP proxy URL for downloading embedding models. Fallback if HTTPS_PROXY is not set.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
envVars.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

envVars.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Overrides the default upstream API host for every tool

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_EMAIL
envVars.description: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account email. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
envVars.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

envVars.description: Namespace the ephemeral pods are created in. Needs a Role/RoleBinding for jobs and pods.

envVars.description: MCP transport: stdio | http | sse. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

envVars.description: Default wall-clock timeout per job, seconds.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum wall-clock timeout a caller may request, seconds.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Cap on combined stdout/stderr before truncation.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES
envVars.description: Cap on the total size of returned artifacts.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_CONCURRENT
envVars.description: Maximum ephemeral pods running at the same time.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_CPU
envVars.description: Pod CPU request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_MEMORY
envVars.description: Pod memory request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_SIDECAR_IMAGE
envVars.description: Helper image used to inject input files and collect artifacts.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_IMAGE
envVars.description: Image carrying git for the clone init container. Empty disables the clone field.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_SECRET
envVars.description: Secret with git tokens, mounted only on the cloner. Empty disables the clone field.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_PVC
envVars.description: Existing PVC mounted into every job pod as a shared cache. Empty = no cache.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_MOUNT_PATH
envVars.description: Where the cache PVC is mounted, e.g. /go/pkg/mod. Empty = no cache.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_JOB_EXTRA_ENV

envVars.description: Optional X-MCP-AUTH token required on every request (http/sse transports only).

envVars.name: KUBECONFIG
envVars.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.

envVars.name: MCP_MODE
envVars.description: Server mode: 'code' (default), compatibility alias 'all', or direct 'tools'.

envVars.name: MCP_CODE_MODE_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated configurable denials inside run_code. Environment overrides JSON; an empty value enables all configurable capabilities.

envVars.name: MCP_ARGO_TOOLS
envVars.description: Argo Workflows capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery.

envVars.name: MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS
envVars.description: Argo CD capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery or explicit remote configuration.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level: 'error', 'warn', 'info' (default), or 'debug'.

envVars.name: MCP_KUBE_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.

envVars.name: MCP_HIDE_SENSITIVE
envVars.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.

envVars.name: MCP_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_JSON_RESPONSE
envVars.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_STATE_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret of at least 32 bytes for signing approval state. Required in HTTP mode and identical across replicas.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_REPLAY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute directory on writable storage shared by every HTTP replica, used to atomically prevent approval replay.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.

envVars.name: KUBE_MCP_FORCE_VM_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Force the standalone code-mode runtime to use node:vm instead of isolated-vm. Set to '1' to enable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_KUBERNETES_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Disable Kubernetes plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_HELM_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Disable Helm plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGO_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGO_TOOLS=off.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGOCD_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS=off.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ALLOW_REQUEST_OVERRIDES
envVars.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ATLAS_TEMPORARY_DATABASE_USER_LIFETIME_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE
envVars.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends — recommended when the HTTP transport is exposed to multiple clients without authentication. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_JS
envVars.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN
envVars.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ELICITATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORTS_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store exported data files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXTERNALLY_MANAGED_SESSIONS
envVars.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_BODY_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS
envVars.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE
envVars.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_INDEX_CHECK
envVars.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOG_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store logs.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOGGERS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_ACTIVE_CONNECTIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open. When exceeded, the scope's least-recently-used connection is closed and its connectionId revoked. The preconfigured connection does not count towards the limit.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_BYTES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http'). Each session holds a full server instance, transport, and timers, so choose a value based on your deployment's available memory; the default is a conservative safety net rather than a recommended production value.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_TIME_M_S
envVars.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MCP_CLIENT_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_FEATURES
envVars.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_PREVIEW_FEATURES
envVars.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for Voyage AI embeddings service (required for creating Atlas Local deployments with auto-embed vector search capabilities).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ALLOW_REQUEST_OVERRIDES
envVars.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ATLAS_TEMPORARY_DATABASE_USER_LIFETIME_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE
envVars.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends — recommended when the HTTP transport is exposed to multiple clients without authentication. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_JS
envVars.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN
envVars.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ELICITATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORTS_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store exported data files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXTERNALLY_MANAGED_SESSIONS
envVars.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_BODY_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS
envVars.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE
envVars.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_INDEX_CHECK
envVars.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOG_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store logs.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOGGERS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_ACTIVE_CONNECTIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open. When exceeded, the scope's least-recently-used connection is closed and its connectionId revoked. The preconfigured connection does not count towards the limit.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_BYTES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http'). Each session holds a full server instance, transport, and timers, so choose a value based on your deployment's available memory; the default is a conservative safety net rather than a recommended production value.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_TIME_M_S
envVars.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MCP_CLIENT_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_FEATURES
envVars.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_PREVIEW_FEATURES
envVars.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for Voyage AI embeddings service (required for creating Atlas Local deployments with auto-embed vector search capabilities).

servers.name: io.github.navapbc/rebar
servers.title: io.github.navapbc/rebar
servers.description: Event-sourced ticket system with a Jira reconciler, exposed as an MCP server.

envVars.name: REBAR_ROOT
envVars.description: Path to the repo root that holds the .tickets-tracker store (defaults to the git toplevel of the working dir).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read tools (no write/mutation tools).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable the billable LLM tools (review_ticket / review_code / scan_spec / verify_completion / review_plan); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_JIRA_SYNC
envVars.description: Set to 1 to allow the live (mutating) Jira reconcile mode; otherwise reconcile is dry-run only.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport for the MCP server: 'stdio' (default) or 'http' (the optional Streamable-HTTP transport).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the Streamable-HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Bind port for the Streamable-HTTP transport (1-65535; default 8000).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: URL path the Streamable-HTTP transport serves on (default /mcp).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact host:port values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact Origin values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge TLS is terminated at the edge; required to bind the Streamable-HTTP transport to a non-loopback host.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge running the Streamable-HTTP transport without a token verifier; required to boot the HTTP transport while auth is off.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable MCP authentication (the composite token verifier + Resource-Server wiring); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES
envVars.description: Comma-separated, ordered list of token-verifier strategies to compose (closed set: static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL
envVars.description: OAuth authorization-server issuer URL advertised in the Protected-Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) when auth is enabled.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
envVars.description: The single resource identifier (RFC 8707 audience) for this server; the composite verifier re-checks every accepted token against it.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated scopes a caller must hold; the SDK returns 403 insufficient_scope when a principal lacks one.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the JSON secrets file for the static-bearer verifier (stores only SHA-256 digests of the accepted tokens).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS endpoint the `jwt` verifier fetches signing keys from (an OIDC provider's .well-known/jwks.json).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected `iss` claim for the `jwt` verifier; falls back to REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL when unset.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHMS
envVars.description: Comma-separated PINNED, asymmetric-only JWS algorithms for the `jwt` verifier (default RS256,ES256); a symmetric algorithm on a JWKS source is refused.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY
envVars.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds applied to exp/nbf validation by the `jwt` verifier (default 60).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN
envVars.description: Minimum seconds between JWKS refetches triggered by an unknown key id (the concurrency-safe flood guard; default 30).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the `jwt` verifier's JWKS fetch (default 10).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_EXPECTED_TYP
envVars.description: When set, the `jwt` verifier requires the JWT header `typ` to equal this (e.g. at+JWT per RFC 9068); unset skips the check.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_JWKS_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback JWKS host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: The `introspection` verifier's RFC 7662 endpoint URL (must be https://); the opaque token is POSTed here on every request (no caching).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: The client id the `introspection` verifier presents to the Authorization Server via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the introspection client secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the server refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback introspection endpoint host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_MISSING_AUD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to accept an active introspection response that OMITS `aud` (many AS do); off by default (fail-closed reject).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the trusted-proxy shared secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the `proxy` verifier refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_HEADER
envVars.description: The header the fronting proxy sends its shared secret on; the identity is trusted only when this matches (constant-time; default x-proxy-auth).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_IDENTITY_HEADER
envVars.description: The header carrying the proxy-authenticated principal identity, trusted only when the secret header validates (default x-forwarded-user).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated fixed scope set granted to proxy-authenticated principals; empty by default (the principal holds no scopes).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT
envVars.description: The `custom` strategy's `module:factory` import string, resolving to a factory that returns a TokenVerifier; a TRUSTED operator config value that loads and executes the operator-configured code at startup (fail-closed on any load error).

envVars.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true so the image is functional out of the box.

envVars.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.

envVars.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access currently ships read-only; door unlocks and credential issuance require session-token auth and are deferred.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST
envVars.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY
envVars.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT
envVars.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH
envVars.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.

servers.name: io.github.piprail/mcp
servers.title: PipRail
servers.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN
envVars.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS
envVars.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT
envVars.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL
envVars.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM
envVars.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW
envVars.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION
envVars.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG
envVars.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG
envVars.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
envVars.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.

envVars.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain + Avalanche, 2,000 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. BNB + Avalanche payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

envVars.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

envVars.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

envVars.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

envVars.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
envVars.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.

envVars.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

envVars.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.

envVars.name: Q402_API_KEY
envVars.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB + Avalanche) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB + Avalanche payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.

envVars.name: Q402_WALLET_ID
envVars.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

envVars.name: CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET
envVars.description: Retrieval-unit size in the embedding model's own tokens. Range 16-128; the ceiling is the model's trained sequence length.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword weight in the weighted RRF fusion, range 0.0-1.0. 0 is vector-only; higher values raise the BM25 contribution.

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Result grouping filter. 'similar' keeps only the closest group; 'related' also keeps the next one. Unset means no grouping filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Drop results whose vector distance exceeds this value. Lower is stricter. Unset means no distance filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Keep chunks from at most this many best-scoring files. Unset means no per-file filter.

envVars.name: RAG_INSTRUCTIONS_APPEND
envVars.description: Extra paragraph appended to the instructions the server hands the client at connect time, for corpus-specific guidance.

servers.title: io.github.shinpr/mcp-local-rag
servers.description: Easy-to-setup local RAG server with minimal configuration

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
